caption:
🫁😮‍💨 Whistling sound when your child breathes? That's a wheeze. Here's what to know.

✅ About 1 in 3 children wheeze before age 3. Many outgrow it: not every wheeze is asthma.

⚡ Common triggers: colds & viruses · dust, mites, pets · smoke (cigarettes, mosquito coils, chulha) · cold air & hard exercise · strong smells & pollen

💚 If your child has an inhaler:
1️⃣ Use the spacer, every time
2️⃣ Preventer every day, even when well
3️⃣ Reliever for attacks, as the doctor planned
4️⃣ Rinse mouth after the steroid inhaler

❌ Please don't:
• Give cough syrups for a wheeze
• Stop the preventer when your child is well
• Smoke near your child
• Use hot steam (burns!)

🚨 Go to hospital NOW if:
• Struggling to breathe, can't talk or feed
• Chest pulling in, ribs showing
• Blue or grey lips
• Reliever not working or needed every 4 hours
• Very sleepy or confused
